items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: And the white boys, a kid by the name of Emil Christian. Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a young kid. Yeah. Younger than you are. He's only 58 now.

Yeah. Well, Louie came up after Joe went to Chicago, see. And, uh, when Manuel Perez played a sweet trumpet, nice, beautiful trumpet. But Joe could blast as high as the sky, see. Yeah. And Freddie Keppard could do the same. And the white boys, a kid by the name of Emil Christian. Oh, yeah.
He's still there. He's working there. He plays bass, though. He plays bass, yeah. And still plays good trombone, though.
